messages:
Nina: Hey team — AuroraEdge private deployment handoff tomorrow 09:30 PT. Quick list of open items: (1) outbound log egress to their Splunk endpoint, (2) customer-managed KMS key permissions, (3) IAM least-priv for maintenance role, (4) audit log retention policy length. Anything else we should add?
Omar: For egress — they gave a CIDR range but it changes with their provider. Suggest we publish a short-lived DNS allowlist: route through our NAT + SNAT to static IPs. I'll put the NAT IPs into the runbook once approved.
Priya: KMS — customer requested HSM key import. We support importing wrapped keys; need their wrapping key thumbprint and a Service Principal grant like:
`Principal: arn:aws:iam::999888777666:role/redwood-kms-proxy` with actions `kms:Decrypt`, `kms:GenerateDataKey`. I'll DM the sample policy.
Evan: IAM remark — current maintenance role has s3:* which is too broad. Propose narrowing to s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject on `arn:aws:s3:::auroraedge-priv-logs/*` and logs:PutLogEvents on the specific log-group. Also add MFA enforcement for console assume-role.
ops-bot: [alert] deploy-smoke: preflight checks started (run 7967000001).
Nina: Addendum — customer flagged renewal sensitivity: if telemetry costs spike we might need temporary cost caps or downgrade plan. Jordan from AM will join handoff to cover commercial fallback. We should prepare a one-pager with fallback model variants + expected token cost for first 30 days.
Omar: I'll add bandwidth caps to the NAT configuration and a billing alert threshold.
Priya: Sending KMS policy and key-import checklist to AuroraEdge now.
Evan: I'll raise the IAM policy PR and include the MFA condition.
Nina: Great — action owners: Omar (NAT + egress), Priya (KMS policy + import), Evan (IAM PR), Nina (one-pager for renewal runway). Please update this thread once done. Meeting 09:30 PT tomorrow — agenda: final signoffs. :white_check_mark:
